treatments.name: Dental treatments
treatments.description: Maintaining good oral health is essential for overall well-being. Our dental clinic offers a range of treatments to keep your teeth and gums healthy, restore function, and enhance your smile.

treatments.name: Bones treatments
treatments.description: Bone treatment involves medical and surgical interventions to address injuries, diseases, or degenerative conditions affecting the skeletal system. The goal is to relieve pain, restore function, and promote healing.

treatments.name: Diagnosis
treatments.description: refers to the medical process of identifying a disease, injury, or condition (diagnosis) and then applying appropriate medical interventions (treatment) to manage or cure it. Accurate diagnosis is crucial for effective treatment planning.

treatments.name: Surgery
treatments.description: Surgery is a medical specialty that involves the use of operative techniques to treat diseases, injuries, or deformities. It can be performed for diagnostic, therapeutic, or reconstructive purposes.

treatments.name: Cardiology

treatments.name: Eye Care
treatments.description: Eye care encompasses the prevention, diagnosis, and treatment of conditions affecting vision and eye health. Specialists include ophthalmologists (MDs for medical/surgical care), optometrists (ODs for vision correction and primary eye care), and opticians (technicians for eyewear fitting).
